Fix summary: /app/backend/knowledge/provenance.py::build_envelope now invokes _coerce_value(value, value_type) both for is_envelope(raw) and bare-value paths, applying: number→int/float via float() then int-check; boolean→lowercased true/1/yes/si/sì/on→True and false/0/no/off/''→False; string_list→[str(x)] wrap for scalars, coerce list items to str; object_list→[{value:x}] wrap for scalars; object→{value:x} wrap for non-dict; string→str(x). Guarded by try/except so non-coercible values pass through untouched. Confirmed by test_01 (mileage_km:'48500'→int 48500), test_01b (auto_renew:'true'→bool True), test_01c (residents:'Marco'→['Marco']).
